basic_info.description: Great and relaxing panoramic bay and city views from this beautiful Twin Peaks Condominium. This 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath, top floor unit includes new kitchen with granite countertops, new carpet on the first floor with open floor plan - wood-burning fireplace - tons of closet space. Spacious double sink bathroom and large bedrooms. Secured parking garage - additional storage space. Located in beautiful Twin Peaks, this 2-story is the place you are looking for. Hop over to Noe Valley or The Castro, among other places in under 10 minutes. Great access to both I-280 and HWY101 for commuters. Don't miss this fabulous condominium & the Gorgeous Views.
